items.html: And it is possible that these two crowns are the river that spreads to its sides, which is the Dalet in the Hey, which spread upward and downward on its two sides. And that is 'a river goes out of Eden,' for the Yod, which is Eden, spread this way and that way, upward and downward, and became a Dalet, as is stated in the portion Vayikra. And the third side in the Hey is the Tifferet, which was conceived and was within her womb, and afterward went out, in the secret of the Vav of the Name. And the two sides are the hidden Hesed and Gevura; and it spread to its sides and bequeathed them to the pleasant son.
